name: Mibu (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Mibu town emblem in white: a ring beneath a winged device of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Mibu, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 July 1960.

features.role: Mibu town emblem — a ring beneath a winged device of horizontal strokes
